items.headline: Anthropic closes 17% above its IPO price on day one
items.summary: After a choppy first session on Nasdaq, the Claude maker's shares finished well above the $83 offer price, a rare bright spot on a day the wider market slid.

items.headline: Nvidia posts a $115.8bn quarter and guides higher
items.summary: Revenue roughly doubled year on year, driven by data centre sales and the first big quarter of Vera Rubin chips, with next-quarter guidance of about $130bn ahead of expectations.

items.headline: Isomorphic Labs raises $5bn for AI drug discovery
items.summary: The DeepMind spin-out's Series C takes its disclosed funding to $7.7bn, though none of its designed molecules has reached human trials yet.

items.headline: SpaceX scrubs classified Space Force launch, retries Friday
items.summary: The Falcon 9 carrying the USSF-317 national security payload from Vandenberg stood down on Thursday night and is now aiming for Friday.

items.headline: OpenAI points GPT-6 at fundamental physics
items.summary: A physicist's guest post on OpenAI's new science blog describes a model-assisted candidate lattice formulation of the Standard Model, with a long preprint and plenty of caveats; one to watch as physicists pick it apart.

items.headline: Tonight in Cavan: mixed, Moon-washed skies
items.summary: This run couldn't load a fresh Met Éireann forecast, so check before heading out. A bright waxing gibbous Moon (full on the 24th) dominates the evening and sets in the early hours; darkness from about 18:15. Verdict: mixed, best for the Moon and bright planets in any clear breaks, deep-sky only after Moonset.

items.headline: GTA 6 reportedly tops $2bn on launch day
items.summary: Industry estimates put Rockstar's first-day sales above $2bn, which would make it the biggest entertainment launch ever, with analysts saying one day may cover Take-Two's quarterly forecast.

items.headline: Take-Two braced for record-shattering numbers
items.summary: The launch drew huge fanfare worldwide and Take-Two is expected to break sales records; there's still no PC release date. Nothing new on the Witcher, Cyberpunk 2 or Borderlands watchlist today.

items.headline: Polaris 40 tomorrow: McNally defends his ADCC upset
items.summary: Irish grappler Sam McNally, who beat top seed Garry Tonon at ADCC 2022, meets him again for the Polaris lightweight title in a sold-out Southampton; Tonon has never lost at Polaris and returns after nine years.

items.headline: UFC Qatar weigh-ins today
items.summary: Fighters hit the scales in Doha ahead of Saturday's card headlined by Jiri Prochazka vs unbeaten Navajo Stirling, with Aljamain Sterling vs Kevin Vallejos and Dan Hooker vs Brian Ortega also on the main card.

items.headline: Russell edges Gasly in wet Vegas FP2
items.summary: George Russell topped a rain-soaked second practice by just 0.071s from Alpine's Pierre Gasly, with Leclerc third, Hadjar fourth and Piastri fifth.

items.headline: FP1 a washout for lap times
items.summary: The opening session was so wet that no representative times were set, leaving teams short on dry running before qualifying. Quiet on the GT and endurance front.
